segments.en: It is day 5. Alex is still new on the team. Alex is new, so the team uses short sentences. In the morning, Maria helps me use the "input" and "process data" for a small task. During our chat, she says "I'd like to order ..." and "Could I have ...?". I answer clearly and ask one short question. After lunch, I work with the team on GitHub and practise "push changes" and "pull changes". The task is small, but I understand a little more than yesterday.

segments.zh: 第 5 天 · 入门故事。今天把“输入、处理与输出、点餐、远程同步”放进 Alex 的连续故事。Alex is new on the team. The sentences are short, clear, and easy to repeat.先听一遍，再遮住中文复述；最后把 Alex 换成自己。本段词汇：input, process data, I'd like to order ..., Could I have ...?, push changes, pull changes。

推送更改，把本地提交发送到远程仓库

segments.en: It is day 5. Alex is still new on the team. Alex is new, so the team uses short sentences. In the morning, Maria helps me use the "parameter" and "return value" for a small task. During our chat, she says "Could we have the bill?" and "Is service included?". I answer clearly and ask one short question. After lunch, I work with the team on GitHub and practise "upstream remote" and "sync with remote". The task is small, but I understand a little more than yesterday.
